verdict.rationale: New Relic's Alerts feature lets users define thresholds/conditions on any signal and automatically route notifications to the correct system or team (docs-5, docs-34), with NRQL-based conditions as the primary alert type (docs-3, docs-21, docs-25) — this is a direct rule-based, event-triggered automation capability. There's also a forward-looking mention of moving to 'automated remediation' (docs-38), though details are thin. missing for 10: concrete documentation of remediation/webhook actions beyond notification routing, and independent/hands-on validation of the automation-on-event workflow.
